For fil"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"e attachments, use the official feature (drag or paste files into the composer)."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Action | Effect |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Click upload icon | System file picker (multi-select) → smart routing → attachment rail and/or pat"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"h text |

| Mod"},{"id":"p9s9","text":"el without image support | Image falls back to archive + path text (never sent as an image block, no"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"out image support | Image falls back to archive + path text (never sent as an image block, no 400) |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- Single-file limit: **64 MB** (DeepSeek Files API hard limit; the local attachment store defaults t"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"o 20 MB — see *Large images* below)

Conservative fallback: `v0.1.4` — `dsh plugin add github:a903067276-rgb"},{"id":"p14s6","text":"/dsh-file-upload#v0.1.4` |
| 0.1.0-rc.6 and older | `v0.1.2` — `dsh plugin add github:a903067276-rgb"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"/dsh-file-upload#v0.1.2` | Last release without the settings card (the card uses the rc.7+ keyed slo"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"oad#v0.1.2` | Last release without the settings card (the card uses the rc.7+ keyed slot contract) |"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"- No extra shell needed: the host half is pure Node (`node:fs`), no system commands required on any "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"a shell needed: the host half is pure Node (`node:fs`), no system commands required on any platform."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"- **Host** (`lib/index.js`): `POST /api/file-upload/save` — validates the session and size, writes t"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"he base64 payload to `<library>/images/<YYYY-MM-DD>/` (`mode=image`) or `<library>/files/<YYYY-MM-DD"},{"id":"p17s3","text":">/` (`mode=file`) with **pure Node**; `POST /api/file-upload/save-folder` — takes a relative-path + "},{"id":"p17s4","text":"base64 list and rebuilds the tree under `<library>/files/<date>/<timestamp>-<folder>/` (each segment"},{"id":"p17s5","text":" sanitized, `..` rejected to prevent traversal); `GET/POST /api/file-upload/config` reads/writes the"},{"id":"p17s6","text":" settings (official `settings` service) and exposes the host image limit plus whether the current se"},{"id":"p17s7","text":"ssion's model accepts images — resolved from the same model-route source the official UI uses (model"},{"id":"p17s8","text":"-selection projection → request header → `agentDefaultModel`, with the legacy `apiProxy.sessions.mod"},{"id":"p17s9","text":"els` fallback on older DSH releases).
- **Client** (`lib/client.js`): registers the upload icon in t"},{"id":"p17s10","text":"he `conversation.input.left` seat; capture-phase document listener takes over file drags and reads d"},{"id":"p17s11","text":"ragged folders via `webkitGetAsEntry`; routing: supported image + official on + model supports + wit"},{"id":"p17s12","text":"hin host limit → archive + `conversation.createDraftImages` + `inputActions.addImages` (the official"},{"id":"p17s13","text":" InputBar's own mechanism) → official attachment rail (no path text); anything else degrades to arch"},{"id":"p17s14","text":"ive + path text; >64 MB is refused with a notice.
- **Error boundary**: a render crash degrades to a"},{"id":"p17s15","text":" small "⚠ upload component error" chip instead of unmounting the whole composer."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Why this plugin exists"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"DSH natively rejects dragged-in images when the current model doesn't support them. This plugin rout"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"es images through the **official attachment path** when the model can see them (so they ride the Dee"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"pSeek Files API with `file_id` reuse), keeps a **user-accessible archive copy** you can find later, "},{"id":"p19s4","text":"and falls back to plain **path text** otherwise — a plain-text message that passes the model's image"},{"id":"p19s5","text":" check and works with any model or vision plugin (it bypasses DSH's native image rejection because n"},{"id":"p19s6","text":"o image block is ever submitted on the fallback path)."}],"truncated":true}
